question: What initiative did Dr. Jitendra Singh launch in May 2025 as MoS PMO and MoS Personnel?
solution:
The correct answer is __**e-Civil List 2025 e-book**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **e-Civil List 2025 e-book** was launched by Dr. Jitendra Singh in May 2025 in his capacity as Minister of State (MoS) PMO and MoS Personnel.
 
• This initiative is part of the government’s effort to digitize official records and make them accessible to stakeholders in a user-friendly manner.
 
• The e-Civil List provides comprehensive information about IAS officers across India, including their postings, cadre, and career details.
 
• It aims to enhance transparency, accountability, and ease of access to the details of civil servants for administrative and public use.
 
• The platform leverages technology to ensure up-to-date record maintenance and helps in better governance and human resource management of IAS officers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Grievance Redress Portal**
 
 
• This is an online platform designed to address public grievances efficiently and transparently.
 
• It allows citizens to register complaints related to government services and schemes, ensuring timely resolution.
 
• The portal is part of the government’s ongoing efforts to improve governance and citizen-centric service delivery.
 
• While significant, this initiative was not launched in May 2025.
 
 
 
• **Central Police Commemoration Day**
 
 
• Observed annually on October 21, this day is dedicated to honoring police personnel who have sacrificed their lives in the line of duty.
 
• It was first commemorated in 1959 following the tragic loss of police forces during a skirmish with Chinese forces at Hot Springs, Ladakh.
 
• While it is an important event, it is not related to the initiative launched by Dr. Jitendra Singh in May 2025.
 
 
 
• **Digital Land Records Survey**
 
 
• This initiative focuses on digitizing land records to streamline land ownership documentation and minimize disputes.
 
• It aims to create a transparent and accessible database of land records for citizens and government authorities.
 
• It is a separate program from the e-Civil List 2025 e-book and was not launched in May 2025.
